title: dsh-ops bench run.json
description: One sealed measurement, and the only place bench data lives (bench/README.md, hard boundary 1). The panel and the comparison read this document; nothing is inlined into panel.html. Event bodies are written as NDJSON while a sweep runs (crash safe) and merged into this document when it is sealed. Every numeric field names its unit in its description.

schemaVersion.description: Contract revision of THIS document; a reader must reject a version it does not know. Bumped only when a field changes meaning.

meta.description: Provenance of the sweep: what ran, where, on which runtime, and the exact command line.

benchVersion.description: Version of the bench harness (package.json of the dsh-ops checkout).

mode.description: Measurement mode: "ab" is the model-driven token A/B, "tools" is the model-free deterministic tool-level comparison.

platform.description: Host tag as <platform>-<arch>, e.g. linux-x64 or win32-x64.

node.description: Node.js version the runner ran on, e.g. v24.21.0.

dsh.description: Version of the dsh launcher both arms were measured with, or null when unknown.

model.description: Model id both arms used, or null for the model-free mode.

gitSha.description: Commit the checkout was on, or null when it could not be read.

gitBranch.description: Branch the checkout was on, or null when it could not be read.

argv.description: The command line that produced this document, one array element per argv entry.

startedAt.description: Wall-clock start of the sweep, ISO 8601 UTC.

endedAt.description: Wall-clock end of the sweep, ISO 8601 UTC, or null while it is still running.

arms.description: Compact identity of the two arms compared: label and profile fingerprint. The full descriptor is the top-level `arms`.

base.description: The baseline side's label, profile name, and profile fingerprint.

label.description: Baseline arm label, also its profile name, e.g. bench-base.

profile.description: Baseline profile name whose resolved configuration was measured.

profileHash.description: SHA-256 in hex of the baseline's dumped configuration.

cand.description: The candidate side's label, profile name, and profile fingerprint.

label.description: Candidate arm label, also its profile name, e.g. bench-ops.

profile.description: Candidate profile name whose resolved configuration was measured.

profileHash.description: SHA-256 in hex of the candidate's dumped configuration.

arms.description: The two sides of the comparison, described fully enough to reproduce them.

results.description: One record per task x repeat x arm: the measurement rows the comparison and the panel pair up.

verify.description: Run-level rollup of the per-row check results, for the panel's scoring tab.

checks.description: Number of individual checks recorded across every row, as a count.

passed.description: How many of those checks passed, as a count.

failed.description: How many of those checks failed, as a count.

degraded.description: True when at least one row cannot support a cost conclusion (timed out, crashed, or usage was not fully reported).

notes.description: Human-readable caveats, one sentence per array item.

events.description: How the event stream is archived: written as NDJSON during the sweep, merged into this document when it is sealed.

layout.description: On-disk layout while the sweep ran: one NDJSON file per task x repeat x arm.

merged.description: True when this document carries the event bodies in results[].events.inline; false when only the NDJSON files hold them.

mergedAt.description: When the NDJSON files were merged, ISO 8601 UTC, or null while unsealed.

files.description: The NDJSON files this document was sealed from, each hashed so a reader can prove the merge.

path.description: Path relative to the run directory, with forward slashes.

events.description: Number of event lines in this file, as a count.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file in hex, or null when it was not hashed.

archive.description: The manifest of one sealed run directory: every file that is part of the evidence, with its size and hash.

path.description: Path relative to the run directory, with forward slashes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file in hex, or null when it was not hashed.

role.description: What the file is: the contract document, the event stream, captured stderr, a rendered report, the panel, a runner log, or anything else.

arm.description: One arm of the comparison: what it was called, which profile contents it ran, and how it was launched.

label.description: Arm label, also the profile name it ran, e.g. bench-base.

profile.description: Profile name whose resolved configuration was measured.

profileHash.description: SHA-256 in hex of the arm's dumped configuration, the single-variable fingerprint.

dshPath.description: Absolute path of the lib/bin.js the arm ran, or null when unknown.

dshVersion.description: dsh version the arm ran, or null when unknown.

env.description: The environment overrides this arm was given, as name -> value (null means the name was removed).

result.description: One measured task x repeat x arm row.

taskId.description: Id of the task this row measured.

repeatIndex.description: 1-based repeat number of this task within the sweep.

arm.description: Which arm this row belongs to, by arm label.

verify.description: One entry per declared check, in declared order.

metrics.description: The measured numbers of one row. Token counts are absolute totals for the row, never deltas.

startedAt.description: Wall-clock start of this row, ISO 8601 UTC.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of this row in milliseconds (ms), measured around the child process.

exit.description: Child process exit code, or null when the row timed out or was killed before it could exit.

timedOut.description: True when the task deadline killed this row.

steps.description: Model steps (requests) in this row, as a count.

toolCalls.description: Tool invocations in this row, as a count.

usageReported.description: True when every step reported usage. False makes the token totals a lower bound, so the row cannot support a cost conclusion.

toolCallsByName.description: Tool invocations broken down by tool name, each value a count.

turnEndReason.description: Why the model loop ended, as reported by the runtime, or null when unknown.

usage.description: Token usage of one row, split the way the runtime reports it.

inputTokens.description: Uncached prompt tokens, as a count of tokens.

outputTokens.description: Completion tokens, as a count of tokens.

cacheReadTokens.description: Prompt tokens served from the prompt cache, as a count of tokens.

cacheWriteTokens.description: Prompt tokens written into the prompt cache, as a count of tokens.

reasoningTokens.description: Reasoning tokens the provider billed, as a count of tokens; 0 when the provider does not report them.

check.description: One declared verification check and its outcome on this row.

type.description: Check type as declared in the task file, e.g. fileEquals.

target.description: What was checked: the path, directory, or command, or null when the check has no target.

pass.description: True when the check held on this row.

detail.description: One line saying what was expected and what was found; empty when pass is true.

evidence.description: Path of the evidence for this check, relative to the run directory, or null.

eventRef.description: Where this row's event body is: an NDJSON file during the sweep, inline after the merge.

format.description: ndjson = the body is still in a file; inline = the body is in `inline` in this document.

file.description: Path of the NDJSON file relative to the run directory, or null once the body is inline.

count.description: Number of event lines for this row, as a count.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the NDJSON file in hex, or null when it was not hashed.

inline.description: The event objects themselves, present only after sealing (format inline); each is one NDJSON line, verbatim.
